iteration_schedule: 21 fixed prelocation, 14 velocity-only, then five joint 14-iteration blocks; compare blocks 3 and 5 for extra-iteration sensitivity. Holdout 35 fixed-model iterations then another 35 solely to check nuisance-location convergence.
training_rule: Preserve preceding cap5/cap8 selections; exclude unresolved training phases/events only after raw-waveform review, reapply unchanged event screen. Add any newly reviewed eligible events. No review or selection on 2025.
comparison: All three previously declared families, all six sensitivities; no family selected using 2025 scores.
holdout: Hash-locked. All training fits and sensitivity outputs must be frozen before final 2025 evaluation. Never repick, reassociate, reweight or remove its arrivals.
gate_on_refitting: Only after justified training observation changes; no refit of unchanged input.
inference_at_registration: Two of twelve target files had already been picked; no new batch association or waveform review had occurred.
review_focus: Previously flagged training ambiguities in current selected events; new target-station window.
